Markup-fidelity fixture for the LOADER-CENTER utility (keen `Loader.loader_center/1`, svelte `feedback/LoaderCenter.svelte`). SCOPE: CONTAINER ONLY — a flex-column centering wrapper (.pa-loader-center) whose slot holds a spinner + optional caption. Like list.json, the harness feeds the slot plain TEXT (HTML-escaped by the dumper), so the real child (a spinner/

) can't flow through; the body is a bare text token. This fixture proves ONLY what the container emits: its

tag, its pa-loader-center class, and its class passthrough. Authored from dist/css/main.css + snippets/loaders.html + _loaders.scss.

propsVocabulary.body: the centered content area — filled with plain slot text in this container-only slice (real spinner + caption children are out of scope)
propsVocabulary.extraClass: extra classes appended verbatim (svelte `class`, keen `class`) — class passthrough, not a core feature

goldenConventions: Structural only. .pa-loader-center is a bare flex-centering <div> with NO modifiers (grep '\.pa-loader-center--' on main.css is empty). The body slot is a plain text token. Attribute + class-token order and whitespace are normalized away.

features.//: Feature→class contract authored from dist/css/main.css. The .pa-loader-center block has ZERO modifiers — the container contract is minimal: base class + a body slot + class passthrough. capability axis-1 reverse-check sees no pa-loader-center--* to claim.

extraClass.note: class passthrough — appended verbatim, not a core feature

scenarios.name: basic
scenarios.note: The blessed container: a <div class="pa-loader-center">. Both wrappers emit <div>.

scenarios.name: extra-class
scenarios.note: Class passthrough — the extra class is appended after pa-loader-center; token order is normalized away.
